about: Peers is a client-side demo of verified reviews across every category: a responsive photo-gallery interface built as a single HTML file, with no build step and no server required.

features.title: One file per build
features.body: All HTML, CSS and JavaScript live in a single file for desktop and another for mobile.

features.title: Works offline
features.body: Both builds open by double-click and run completely offline in any modern browser.

features.title: Client-side only
features.body: No network calls at all; demo data is kept in your browser's local storage.

features.title: Optional Python backend
features.body: A zero-dependency standard-library server adds persistence without ever modifying the front-end files.

privacy: Works completely offline when opened directly from the file.
All state is stored in your browser's localStorage.
